name: Four walls of the fifty-routes campaign
statement: 22 of 50 routes reduce to one of four walls: pointwise (averaged or modulus-only inputs carry no every-window information), verified height, flow-blindness (SL2-class soft hypotheses), RH-equivalence (object restates RH, GRH or the explicit formula). Other classes: method-cap, Euler-blind, consumes-zeros, measurement.

name: Certified Weil positivity: four outcomes
statement: Every certified Weil-positivity result of routes 11-15, 19, 26, 44 is inside the verified height, blind above a finite horizon, Euler-blind (passes a same-gamma-factor twin with off-line zeros), or equivalent to (G)RH at full support.

name: Route-P combined value 0.145276368594868
statement: Lambda <= 36319092148717/250000000000000 certified relative to the route-P ledger (round 7 campaign certificates, 3-band layout, 281 lambda<2 kernels). Depends on Raymond chain G0, Lemma B, Theorem B'_m, one engine, RH verified to 3.0001753e12. Internal referee only; 0.145 not certified.

name: Conditional value 0.116091488672439 on the 7/8 half-plane
statement: Route-P consumer started at q0 = 9/16 + eps gives 0.116091488672439, conditional on zeta nonvanishing for Re s > 7/8 (openai/math 003, Lean), chain G0 and the route-P ledger. The 7/8 start supplies -0.0309 of the step from 0.1453.

name: Raymond chain G0 unrefereed
statement: AF Part I/II, Lemmas 2-3, Theorem 4/4', G0-c and G0-d (OP) have internal review only. G0 is the binding premise of both sub-0.2 values (0.1452..., 0.1160...). G0-c and G0-d are not formalised; Lemma R is Lean-checked conditional on AF (4.6) and Phi' = Re beta_t.

name: P47 late-cell WOL-C floors (cells 417-424)
statement: Lambda < 0.145 by route P needs 125 missing P47 late-cell floors; cells 417-424 (0.88 sharp) need point bound + 0.008 and stalled at 0.10-0.19. Floors are suprema over the Kronecker torus with all prime phases free and carry no height coordinate.

name: Lowered barrier floor moves no Lambda value
statement: The barrier floor is not an input of route P; under Polymath15 Thm 1.2 it enters only through containment (t0 <= 129/800, f^2 <= y0^2), which does not bind. 0.1787854 and 0.1758354 are unchanged at every floor from 0.1809 to 0.022.

name: Lemma MP3 (multi-point phase lemma)
statement: For omega_s >= 0, |z| = |u_s| = 1, eps = +-1, c_s >= c0 >= 0: sum omega_s c_s [1 - eps Re(z u_s)] >= c0 (sum omega_s - |sum omega_s u_s|), sharp in z. One pair without centre weight is Raymond's Lemma 3. Worth -7.86e-7 on Lambda.

name: Linearity of the floor in the probe measure
statement: Kernel inequality, self cap and the Lemma H2 far-field inequality are linear in the probe measure, so mixtures of certified components need no new kernel certificate (lambda = min of components). Six certified lambda<2 two-point kernels give -2.28e-4.

name: Fejer-Riesz branch-reduction lemma for fibre maxima
statement: The fibre function g_q (terms |sin k theta|, k <= 7, |sin theta/2|, max(h_s,0)) has sup equal to the max over 1024 sign/branch choices of a trigonometric polynomial of degree <= 14; whole-circle Fejer-Riesz certifies it with residual <= 1.05e-12. Gain equals grid Lipschitz slack only.

name: Theorem B'_m: multi-band Lemma B with line walls
statement: Band argument split into m bands by certified line walls and local RH windows (width > 7252): 4 bands give 0.145620383931826, band 1 binds. Slab walls instead of line walls cost about c f^4/8 in Lambda. Unrefereed.

name: Theorems S and N: sparse RH verification in the Lemma-B framework
statement: RH must be verified contiguously to a head x_*(tau); above it one local window wider than the far-field distance D_K = 921-1639 with right wall >= x_**(tau) replaces contiguous verification to x_**/2 (about 1.73e12 ordinate units at tau = 0.145). Framework-relative.

name: Lemma CG^lambda: weighted Euler mollifier head coefficients
statement: The head coefficient of prod_{p in {2,3,5}} (1 - lambda_p b_t(p) p^{-s}) is a convex combination of Lemma CG covers with weights prod lambda_p prod (1 - lambda_p); so 0 <= c_n(t_L) <= c_n(t) <= c_n(t_R) for lambda_p in [0,1]. lambda = 1 is already optimal.

name: Polymath/Raymond hybrid gives no gain
statement: Joining lemma B'_P: a hybrid's bound is the max over its bands, Lambda <= max(U_1..U_m, t0 + y0^2/2). Any Polymath band from existing rows gives 0.1758354, which is +0.030141 above route P; the best split has no Polymath band.

name: Optimised barrier height set W4
statement: A 10-knot piecewise-linear multiplier of Raymond's PLAN heights added to the multi-height menu gives 0.145637425999752 alone (-5.67e-5), and exactly 0 once the route-3 kernels are present. Local, not global, optimum.

name: Lean: Lemma CG covering identity and G0-a
statement: Lean 4 theorem: c_n(t) = sum_{d|(n,30)} mu(d) beta_d(t) b_t(n/d) satisfies 0 <= c_n(t') <= c_n(t) for n >= 1, 0 <= t' <= t, with no hypotheses. Covering identity over ordered half-edge atoms exp(t a_p a_q/4) - 1.

name: Lean: zero-free half-plane to strip and Lambda
statement: Lean theorem: zeta(s) != 0 for Re s > theta >= 1/2 implies every zero of H_t, t >= 0, has Im(z)^2 <= max((2 theta - 1)^2 - 2t, 0), and Lambda <= (2 theta - 1)^2/2. theta = 7/8 gives Lambda <= 9/32; theta = 1 gives 1/2 from Mathlib alone.

name: Multi-rung Weil symbol w_K
statement: For support 2a <= ln(K+1) the pole-free Weil form is W(h) = (1/2 pi) int w_K |h^|^2 with w_K = 2 theta' - sum_{n<=K} beta_n cos(t ln n), beta_n = 2 Lambda(n)/sqrt n; rungs n > K drop out, so a certificate at ln(K+1) covers every smaller support.

name: ARB-LEGE certified margins past ln 3
statement: Pole-free Weil positivity W(h) >= c ||h||^2 certified at 2a <= ln 4 (c = 8.55e-8), ln 5 (2.25e-12), ln 6 (6.25e-17); margins decay like 10^(-4.8 e^{2a}). The whole range lies below the verified-height crossover 2a = 7.764.

name: Virtual rungs: positive-extension freedom outside |u| < 2a
statement: Adding cosines with frequencies |u_j| >= 2a (u = ln r, r rational, r >= K+1 or r <= 1/(K+1)) leaves W unchanged on support 2a; with the floor lemma w_K + f >= 2 theta'(T) - F for F >= sup_torus(P - f). Best floor is lambda_max of the rung operator (Krein extension).

name: Semilocal Fourier transform F_S for S = {inf, 2, 3}
statement: F_S eta(w) = sum_{a,b>=-1} c_2(a) c_3(b) eta^(2^a 3^b w), c_p(k) = 1 - 1/p (k >= 0), -1/p (k = -1); Mellin multiplier rho_2 rho_3 with rho_p(s) = (1 - p^{s-1})/(1 - p^{-s}), unimodular on Re s = 1/2. For g-support < ln 4, W = L_S - D_S exactly. Conditional on Connes-Consani framework.

name: Remainder share D_S/L_S cannot separate prime sets
statement: On the unit-norm W-minimiser, 1 - share = lambda_W/L_S(h0) by definition for any decomposition W = L_S - D_S; share is 99.71%-99.99997% on [ln 3, ln 4] for S = {inf,2}, {inf,2,3}, {inf,2,3,5} alike. A statement about the metric at cutoff 1, not about the S -> all primes limit.

name: Semilocal trace side positive and growing with S
statement: Trace-side symbol L^_S(0): +0.0650 (S = {inf,2}), +0.0504 (S3), +0.10 to +0.12 (S = {inf,2,3}), positive on [0,30]; Galerkin lambda_min(L_S23) = 0.175-0.225, lambda_min(L_S235) = 0.22-0.26. Not a certificate; the limit S -> all primes with cutoff -> infinity was not tested.

name: LAC-EQ: lacunary Weil positivity as Caratheodory interpolation
statement: Weil positivity on the cone spanned by e^{-nu t}, nu in Lambda, holds iff a Caratheodory function on Re w > 0 interpolates xi'/xi(1/2 + nu) on Lambda (Nevanlinna-Pick, Stieltjes in x = nu^2). For Blaschke Lambda (sum 1/nu < infinity) the problem is indeterminate.

name: Certified Pick margin on the cone {4^k}
statement: Infinite normalised Pick operator of xi on Lambda_4 = {4^k}: M >= 3.6346e-4 I (Arb; head >= 6.12e-4 minus IMS localisation 2.4854e-4). Float margins: 3.89e-9 (2^k), 1.06e-21 (2^{k/2}). Insensitive to zeros above height 80 in a double-zero to quadruple model.

name: Detection horizon of geometric lattices: T h about 7
statement: On lattices 2^{k/m} the Pick operator detects a planted off-line zero only below heights 23.0, 31.7, 39.3, 60.1 (m = 2,3,4,6), T h about 7. Heuristic resolution law Delta(gamma) = 1/sum 2 nu/(nu^2 + gamma^2); reaching 3e12 geometrically needs h ~ 1e-11 and margins ~ e^{-pi^2/h}.

name: Near-Muntz-threshold Blaschke cones nu_k = k^p
statement: For non-separated Blaschke node sets nu_k = k^p, p = 1.1-1.25, the heuristic horizon T_p ~ (2.2 C_p)^{p/(p-1)} passes 3e12 near p = 1.13 while margins tend to 0. Whether such cones carry zero information above the verified height is open; reduction to the pointwise wall is an analogy.

name: Bounded-type lemma for xi'/xi(1/2 + w)
statement: 'A complete discrete (Muntz-complete) node set forces the interpolant G = xi'/xi(1/2 + w), hence RH' is conditional on a bounded-type lemma for xi'/xi(1/2 + w) in Re w > 0; the written argument uses the identity theorem on the whole interval (1, infinity).

name: LAC-SENS: sensitivity of Pick data to horizontal displacement
statement: Moving a zero at ordinate gamma horizontally by delta changes the interpolation data by at most delta^2 sup|g_gamma''| <= 2.914 delta^2/gamma^3. Off-line displacement enters lacunary Pick data at second order with cubic height decay.

name: Family-averaged Weil symbol over characters mod q
statement: Average over the q-2 nonprincipal characters: sigma_F(t) = log(q/pi) + [(q-3) Re psi(1/4 + it/2) + (q-1) Re psi(3/4 + it/2)]/(2(q-2)) - sum beta_n cos(t log n), beta_n = 2 Lambda(n) n^{-1/2}((q-1)[n = 1 mod q] - 1)/(q-2). No pole terms.

name: Family Weil positivity is Euler-blind
statement: Family positivity is certified to 2a about 2 log q (10.0 at q = 257) through orthogonality plus the conductor term log q. A family containing the RH-false Davenport-Heilbronn function is certified positive at 2a = 7.764. At all supports it is GRH for every character mod q.

name: Limit of symbol-floor certificates
statement: For a certificate W >= c ||h||^2 built from a compact Galerkin part with cutoff T: c <= inf_{|t|>=T} sigma(t). A point sigma(t0) < 0 with t0 >= T rules out every such certificate with cutoff T <= t0. Individual characters reach only 2a about 1.95-2.40 by this method.

name: Epstein zeta twins, class number 2-4
statement: 27 Epstein zeta functions of binary quadratic forms (same gamma factor and conductor as zeta_K, no Euler product for non-trivial classes) are Arb-certified Weil-negative at support a* <= A; principal forms fail near log(|D|/4) - 0.13 (even sector, measured).

name: Odd-sector pole term of the Weil form
statement: For odd real test g the pole term becomes -2 (int g sinh(x/2))^2 <= 0 (even: +2 (int g cosh(x/2))^2), so the odd sector can fail first: D = -23 principal form goes negative at about 1.662 (odd) against (1.679, 1.689] (even).

name: Alpoge-Furman mechanism: rank-trace inequality and Sylvester inertia
statement: Proportion >= 2/3 comes from Montgomery's pair-correlation second moment, a rank-trace inequality (Lemma 3.2) and Sylvester inertia applied to a Gabor compression G of Weil's Hermitian form (phi(u) e^{i alpha_k u}, support L = log(T/2 pi)). Measured: tr G = N(T,2T) +- 1 for T = 1e3 to 2.9e5.

name: Closed forms in the 2/3 argument
statement: R(psi0) = 4/3; R(psi_MT) = 1/2 + cot(1/sqrt2)/sqrt2 = 1.32749929632, so 2 - R = 0.672500703679 (Lamzouri C0); R_lambda(psi0) = 1/lambda + lambda/3, H(lambda) = 2 - 1/lambda - lambda/3 increasing on (0,1]; Christoffel value Lambda_2(0) = 5/36, 1 - 2 Lambda_2(0) = 13/18.

name: HL*(k) hierarchy gives proportion 13/18 and 100%
statement: Statements of the Alpoge-Furman preprint (arithmetic reproduced only): under a Hardy-Littlewood-type hypothesis HL*(4) the proportion of zeros on the line is >= 13/18; HL*(k) for all k gives 100%. A proportion statement, not an every-window statement.

name: Conditional one-piece Conrey kappa(theta) table
statement: Conditional on the twisted second moment at length theta: kappa passes 5/12 at theta = 0.58508, 1/2 at 0.75515, 2/3 at 1.31084, equals 0.5884 at theta = 1; d kappa/d theta = 0.5707 at 4/7. Finite-T recipe main term matches direct averages to theta = 2 within 0.52% (55 configurations).

name: Jensen step loses most of the mollified signal
statement: Finite-T kappa with / without the Jensen inequality: 0.4903 / 0.8578 at theta = 4/7, T = 1e6; 0.6587 / 0.9434 at theta = 1. Mollifier alone: mean |psi|^2 / diagonal in [0.992, 1.011].

name: Insensitivity lemma: n-level statistics are beta-blind
statement: A normalised pair or n-level statistic with fixed bounded compactly supported test changes by O(H (log T)^{c_n}/T) when zeros in windows of total length H are changed; so GUE + O(T^{-delta}) is consistent with moving zeros off the line in windows shorter than T^{1-delta}. Point-set statement only.

name: GUE Palm density at a coalesced pair
statement: GUE Palm density given a coalesced pair: rho(u) = 1 - S^2 - 3 S'^2/pi^2 (S the sine kernel), deficit integral exactly 2 (Parseval). Linearised zero-ODE mode rate (4/s^2)(pi theta/2 - theta^2/4). Mirror count 3.021 against required p_req = 4.3743.

name: Mollified Weil form reduces to the plain Weil form
statement: With M(s) = sum_{n<=N} m_n n^{-s}, mu = sum m_n n^{-1/2} delta_{log n}, h = g*g~: sum_rho h^(gamma_rho) M(rho) M(1-rho) = W(G*G~), G = mu*g supported in [-a, a + log N]. So a*_mol >= a*_plain - (1/2) log N; DH passes whenever 2a + log N <= ln 11.

name: Holomorphy constraint on mollifier weights
statement: A weight with an explicit-formula representation equal to |M(1/2 + it)|^2 on the line weights off-line zeros by M(rho) M(1 - rho), not |M(rho)|^2. A finite-length weight Phi(rho) Phi*(1 - rho) with measure support L gives the plain form at A = a + L/2.

name: Explicit Ki-Kim-Lee threshold x0(t)
statement: For t in [t_lo, 1/2] all zeros of H_t with Re z >= x0(t_lo) + 0.47 are real and simple, x0(t) about 4 pi exp(c/t), c = 5.31-5.76 on [0.1, 0.2] (Arb; conditional on Polymath15 Thm 1.3 and de Bruijn). At X = 6e12 it covers only t >= 0.217.

name: Triangle-method floor c > 4.9144 for KKL constants
statement: Every term of D(1/2; t, L) is >= n^{-1/2 - tL/4} and sum_{n=2}^{690988} n^{-1.7286} = 1.0000095 > 1, so D(1/2) < 1 fails whenever t log(x0/4 pi) <= 4.9144 (asymptotically 4(s0 - 1/2), zeta(s0) = 2). Beating route P needs c <= 3.912.

name: Heat-flow zero dynamics as a weighted graph Laplacian
statement: For polynomial heat flows d_t f = -f'': dz/dt = L(z) conj(z), L the Laplacian of the zero graph with weights w_kj = 2/|z_k - z_j|^2; dx/dt = +Lx, dy/dt = -Ly. Conserved: sum z_k, sum x_k y_k; sum z_k^2 = sum z_k(0)^2 + 2n(n-1)t.

name: Majorization theorems for the zero flow are flow-blind
statement: Theorem A: y(t2) is majorized by y(t1) for t1 < t2. Theorem A': sum F(x_k,y_k) is nonincreasing along every heat flow iff F_xx <= 0 <= F_yy. Theorem B: sum psi(|Im z_k|) nonincreasing when y psi'(y) is nondecreasing. All hold for polynomials with non-real zeros: forward-only soft inequalities.

name: de Bruijn bound sharp in y_max; count above a height not monotone
statement: Lambda <= t0 + y_max(t0)^2/2 is sharp as a function of y_max alone (isolated pair z^2 + Y^2 becomes real at t = Y^2/2). The count of zeros above a fixed height is not monotone: {+-0.9i, 0.001 +- 1.3i} goes from 1 to 2 zeros above height 1 by t = 0.02.

name: Csordas-Smith-Varga Lehmer-pair criterion
statement: With D = gamma_{k+1} - gamma_k and G = sum over other +-gamma_j of [(gamma_k - gamma_j)^{-2} + (gamma_{k+1} - gamma_j)^{-2}]: if D^2 G < 4/5 then Lambda >= ((1 - (5/4) D^2 G)^{4/5} - 1)/(2G). Best found over 1.55e6 zeros to 1e13: Lambda >= -4.2577e-6; superseded by Rodgers-Tao.

name: Finite-height small-gap deficit matches CUE_Neff
statement: Pooled gaps s < 0.2 over 1.55e6 zeros near 1e10-1e13: 12834 observed against 13186 GUE (0.9733 +- 0.0088) and 12782 CUE_Neff (1.004 +- 0.009). Replicates Bogomolny-Bohigas-Leboeuf-Monastra. 6.2-6.6% of pairs satisfy D^2 G < 4/5; lambda tail exponent 1.38-1.62.

name: Zero ODE of H_t in unfolded units
statement: Convention d_t H = -H_zz, zeros at z = 2 gamma: dz_k/dt = 2 sum' [1/(z_k - z_j) + 1/(z_k + z_j)] + 1/z_k for simple zeros; with tau = t/Dz^2, Dz = 4 pi/log(gamma/2 pi), dx_k/d tau = 2 sum' 1/(x_k - x_j) up to density-gradient corrections.

name: Zeros miss the Dyson loop identity by an arithmetic term
statement: For CUE_N, E[g D] = -1 exactly (beta = 2 Ward identity). Zeta zeros at T about 1e6: Q = -0.9414 +- 0.003-0.004; Q + 1 = c 12 Lambda_B/L^2 with c = 0.434 +- 0.008 over L in [7,12], Lambda_B = 1.57314; equivalent beta_eff about 2.13. Finite-tau runs unfinished.

name: Local-count channel capped at L/4; triangle method below de Bruijn ceiling
statement: S_t(x,eta) = -Im(H_t'/H_t)(x + i eta) is the Poisson(eta)-smoothed zero count, and any x-uniform lower bound q satisfies q <= L/4 + o(1). The Polymath15 triangle criterion at X controls arg H_t only above sqrt(1-2t) for t <= 0.137. Ideal B2 channel ceiling Lambda about 0.148.

name: Modular-surface scattering matrix through the bridge
statement: phi(s) = Lambda(2s-1)/Lambda(2s) = c_inf(s) chi(2s-1) Z(s), c_inf = sqrt(pi) Gamma(s-1/2)/Gamma(s), chi the bridge, Z(s) = zeta(2-2s)/zeta(2s); equivalently phi = beta Z with beta = pi^{2s-1} Gamma(1-s)/Gamma(s), each unimodular on Re s = 1/2. Poles in 0 < Re s < 1/2 are exactly rho/2.

name: Scattering axioms survive moved resonances
statement: Under xi -> xi Q_delta/Q_0 (an on-line pair replaced by an off-line quartet) phi_delta stays unitary on the axis, satisfies phi(s) phi(1-s) = 1, has positive residue at s = 1 and S = phi(s)(s-1)/s stays inner. The de Bruijn-flow phi_t keeps these for every real t.

name: Causality criterion sits at the zeta(1+it) level
statement: The mirror resonance of a zero z = x + iy of H_t has Re s >= 1/2 iff |y| >= 1 iff Re w >= 1. The local all-pass factors z_p(s) = zeta_p(2-2s)/zeta_p(2s) need Re s > 1/2 and Re s < 1/2 at once: their product converges absolutely nowhere.

name: Winding split of the scattering phase
statement: W(T) = W_inf(T) + arg zeta(1 + 2iT)/pi + 1/2, with W_inf(T) ~ (T/pi) log(T/(pi e)). On the axis s = 1/2 + it the bridge is sampled at w = 2it: |chi(2it)| = sqrt(t/pi) sqrt(tanh pi t), cancelled exactly by |c_inf|.

name: Weil symbol of a holomorphic newform
statement: For weight k, level N, trivial character: W(h) = (1/2 pi) int sigma |h^|^2, sigma(t) = log N - 2 log 2 pi + 2 Re psi(k/2 + it) - sum_{log n < 2a} 2 c(n) n^{-1/2} cos(t log n); no pole terms; N enters only as + log N ||h||^2.

name: Worst case over the Ramanujan box is a vertex
statement: lambda_min of the Weil form is concave in the rung amplitudes, so over |lambda_f(p)| <= 2 the worst case is a vertex (lambda(p) = +2). If c0(k,N) = log N - 2 log 2 pi + 2 psi(k/2) > sum_{n<e^{2a}} 4 Lambda(n)/sqrt n then W >= 0; holds for every weight >= 36 at 2a <= log 3.

name: Ramanujan is RH per rung, not for the ladder
statement: For p not dividing N the 11a rung is 1/P_1(p^{-s}) with P_1 the H^1 factor of Z(E_p,T) (Hasse = curve RH); for weight k > 2 the rung lies in H^{k-1} of the Kuga-Sato variety (Deligne). Provable ladder statements are conductor-driven and Euler-blind (weight-24 non-eigenform also certified).

name: Function-field twin-ladder Weil form = minus intersection form
statement: On C x C over F_q with Frobenius graphs Gamma_j and P_j = Gamma_j - H - q^j V: q^j + q^k - Gamma_j.Gamma_k = -P_j.P_k = q^{(j+k)/2} S_{k-j}, S_n = q^{-n/2} sum alpha_i^n. Hodge index on span{P_j} gives Q_TL >= 0, hence RH for the curve.

name: Exact ghost index of the Frobenius Toeplitz matrix
statement: For N >= number of distinct Frobenius eigenvalues, T_N = [S_{j-k}] has exactly nu negative eigenvalues, nu = number of off-circle pairs; curve-RH iff T_{2g} >= 0. R_a(z) = X(q^a z)/X(q^{-a} z) is a degree-2g Blaschke product under RH. Sensitivity lambda_min(T_2g) = -C eps^2 + o(eps^2).

name: Function-field fakes: Euler product without RH
statement: 215 exact polynomials in the census boxes (17 at q = 3, g = 2; 198 at q = 5, g = 2; g = 1: 1 - 5T + 5T^2, 1 + 6T + 7T^2) have an Euler product with nonnegative integer closed-point counts, functional equation, lossless bridge and rationality, with RH false. Lambda_C of fakes: +0.020 to +0.172.

name: Missing surface Spec Z x Spec Z with a Hodge index theorem
statement: The function-field proof lifts to Q only given (O3) a surface playing C x C with a Hodge index theorem on Frobenius-graph classes, and (O1) a regularisation of the infinite zero count (archimedean term as regularised self-intersection). Faltings-Hriljac covers fibred arithmetic surfaces, not the analogue of C x C.

name: de Bruijn-Newman analogue for elliptic curves over F_q
statement: Lambda_E = 4 log(|a|/(2 sqrt q))/(log q)^2 (minus infinity at a = 0); sup over E/F_p tends to 0 along all primes with |sup Lambda_E| <= 4/((2 sqrt p - 1)(log p)^2); 0 exactly for maximal curves over F_{p^2}.

name: Theorem U on the geodesic monoid
statement: For a finite set G of primitive geodesic classes the sieve algebra is span{T_D : D subset G}, dimension 2^|G|; every freeze word followed by a linear functional is L(diag(m) c) for a unique m. Telescope and five-shell identities are telescoping algebra with no zero information. Collapse: 72 instead of 256 for the first 8 classes.

name: Phase gate on sigma = 0.55: Selberg zeta against zeta
statement: On sigma = 0.55, t <= 26, Re Z < 0 on 6.1% of the grid for the PSL2(Z) Selberg zeta against 0% for zeta (min Re zeta = 0.014); modulus-first threshold sigma*(0): zeta 1.578, Selberg 1.173. Attribution confounded by the rho/2 zero family at Re s = 1/4.

name: RH-true / RH-false Selberg control pair
statement: No RH-false control was run in the Selberg sandbox. A pair (cocompact arithmetic group with the half-plane RH-analogue, against a group with an exceptional eigenvalue) would test whether Euler-product calculi over prime geodesics see zero location. Z = det(1 - L_s^2) (Mayer) supplies a transfer operator.

name: Interferometer visibility is vacuous, false or a gauge choice
statement: Split Lambda_F = A(s) + A(1-s), V = 2|A(s)||A(1-s)|/(|A(s)|^2 + |A(1-s)|^2). Exact arms give V0 = sech(log|chi|), a function of the gamma factor alone. A -> A + O with O(1-s) = -O(s) changes V; the bound sup V < 1 is certified false (79 crossings for zeta, t <= 200).

name: Arm split of the completed zeta function at the self-dual point
statement: Lambda(s) = A(s) + A(1-s), A(s) = -1/s + sum_n (pi n^2)^{-s/2} Gamma(s/2, pi n^2). A(s) = -theta3(e^{-pi})/s + 4 psi'(1)/(s(s+2)) + O(t^{-3}), theta3(e^{-pi}) = pi^{1/4}/Gamma(3/4): each arm is ~1/t while Lambda ~ e^{-pi t/4}.

name: Davenport-Heilbronn = partial Euler product times G
statement: a(n mod 5) = (0, 1, kappa, -kappa, -1), kappa = 0.2840790438; a(nm) = a(n) a(m) for m = +-1 mod 5, so F_DH = [Euler product over p = +-1 mod 5] x G(s), G supported on integers built from primes = +-2 mod 5. Log-derivative coefficients c(n) vanish on 1031 non-prime-powers <= 3000, 906 nonzero.

name: Rung Toeplitz (Herglotz) test detects DH at ln 2 / ln 4 / ln 6
statement: Rung moments m_k(p) = c(p^k)/log p; for unitary local degree 1 the Toeplitz T_p^(K) = [m_|i-j|] is PSD. DH fails: lambda_min(T_2^(2)) = -1.15558, Szego limit -1.79360. Onsets sharp against formal local Euler products: ln 2 (unitary, full), ln 4 (even data), ln 6 (Euler only). No zero-location content.

name: Rung data are read from the on-line zeros
statement: From DH's zeros below 130 (71 on-line, 2 off-line pairs): c(2) = 0.1969085883 recovered at support 1.093 (error 3.2e-12), c(4) = -1.4422324 at 1.606; both off-line pairs together contribute 7e-7 / 1.7e-4. At small support Euler detection and off-line-zero detection decouple.

name: Euler-aware Weil radius over unitary rung data
statement: Proposed SDP: Weil positivity over the formal unitary degree-1 rung class, against the archimedean radius 0.9385 and DH's 1.72. The 2026-11 campaign measured class-uniform positivity over tempered local data only to support 0.7228 at conductor 1 (worst case alpha_2 = -1).

statement: For 2a <= ln 2 the prime side of the explicit formula is empty, so a twin and its Euler arm have the same Weil form and no quantity separates them. At conductor 1 there is no DH-type twin with zeta's bridge (Hamburger).

name: Regularised xp models reproduce only the smooth count
statement: Sierra-Rodriguez-Laguna: semiclassical count (E/2 pi)(ln(E/2 pi) - 1) + mu + 2 pi/E; fit constant 0.875007 +- 5.3e-5 (= 7/8). The gamma-phase spectrum theta(E_n) = pi(n - 3/2) misses the zeros by exactly S(T) (rms 0.3108 spacings, correlation 0.9999999994). Fluctuations need primes.

statement: psi_s = -zeta(s, x+1), Delta psi_s = x^{-s}, psi_s(0) = -zeta(s): the boundary condition selects all zeros. An off-line zero with sigma > 1/2 gives growth x^{1-sigma}; reality of the point spectrum on a growth-cap domain of order >= x^{1/2} implies RH (one direction; Delta^{-1} ambiguous).

statement: G1(r) = (zeta'/zeta)'(1 + ir) - B(ir) = sum_{n = p^k} log^2 p n^{-1-ir}; A'(0) = 0, so the Bogomolny-Keating series in L has no 1/L term. The oscillating part (Hardy-Littlewood factor A) has no proof.

name: de Branges Hamiltonian of Xi + i Xi' restates RH
statement: Lagarias E = A - iB, A = Xi, B = -Xi' is Hermite-Biehler iff RH. Finite-N chain is the reversed counting-measure Jacobi chain (weights 1/A'(x)^2); H = diag(h, 1-h). E_a(z) = Xi(z + ia) ~ Xi + ia Xi' as a -> 0: H_a positive for every a > 0 is the zero-free-strip ladder T3.

statement: lambda_n = n [z^n] log xi(1/(1-z)) > 0 certified for 1 <= n <= 10^4 (Arb); lambda_1 = 0.0230957, osc_1 = gamma_E exactly. Weaker than verified height implies. The 7/8 half-plane gives only |1 - 1/rho|^2 <= 1 + O(1/gamma^2): no all-n positivity.

statement: Lean: with G_t(n) = exp(t log^2 n/4) and D = multiplication by log n (Leibniz for Dirichlet convolution), beta(t) is the unique solution of beta * G_t = D G_t; beta(0) = Lambda; 4 d beta_n/dt = log^2(n) beta_n + 2 sum_{de=n} beta_d (log e) beta_e; hence beta_n(t) >= 0 and nondecreasing on t >= 0.

statement: kappa(P) = sup{Lambda(F) : F in P} over the de Bruijn class. kappa(Strip_Y) = Y^2/2 without Phi > 0: critical strip 1/2, QRH 7/8 gives 9/32, QRH 11/12 gives 25/72. Proportion, zero-density and 'all but finitely many on the line' add no kappa beyond their strip.

statement: Lambda((z^2 + Y^2) cos(cz)) = (sqrt(1 + 4 c^2 Y^2) - 1)/(4 c^2), tending to Y^2/2 as c -> 0. For c >= T the fixed-support Weil form satisfies W_T >= 0 iff 2c >= sinh(2YT)/Y - 2T; lower ladder T^2 kappa_low -> 0.349.

statement: Route 43 left open whether zeros of H_{-tau} leave every strip for every tau > 0 (measured: H_{-1} zero at 5040.39 + 1.41i; heuristic reach tau log(x/4 pi)/2 - 1). The 2026-11 campaign proved it (internal): every horizontal-strip statement true for xi is flow-critical; holds for DH.

statement: For real g = g_e + g_o the cross-correlations cancel in G(x) = int g(y) g(y+x) dy, so W(g) = W(g_e) + W(g_o) for every linear functional of G. A real zero beta in (1/2,1) contributes -(int g sinh((beta-1/2)x))^2 in the odd sector and +(int g cosh)^2 in the even.

statement: At the binding cells sigma_eff = (1+h)/2 in [0.88, 1.59]; labels <= 10 carry 93-98% of first-order variance. Steinhaus Monte Carlo: sd 0.099-0.115, Kronecker lower bounds 3.7-5.1 sd above the mean, lighter-than-Gaussian tails. Multiplicative-chaos maximum asymptotics do not apply.

statement: Arb lower bounds on sup over the prime-phase torus of the leading-order source (labels <= 690988): >= 0.533514111339326 at t = 0.075. Any floor improvement is capped at U2 = 0.144254643222956; box growth 3-7x per added prime, k >= 6 primes out of reach.

statement: If |G| = |xi| on the line and G* = G (G*(s) = conj G(1 - conj s)) then G^2 = xi^2, G = +-xi. Either symmetry alone fails: xi B~_rho B~_{1-rho} keeps FE without reality, xi B~_rho B~_{conj rho} keeps reality without FE.

name: Two-line zero detector D(w) (Poisson-Jensen)
statement: For F = zeta(s)(s-1)/s: D(w) = log|F(w)| - P_w[log|F(1/2 + i.)|] = sum_{beta > 1/2} log|B_rho(w)| <= 0 on Re w > 1/2. Evaluated on Re w = sigma1 >= 1 it determines all zeros with beta > 1/2; found 8 DH off-line zeros below 400 (sigma1 > 1.39514 for DH).

name: One line + one interior value (Balazard-Saias-Yor extension)
statement: J(a) = log|F(a)| deficit = sum_{beta > 1/2} -log|B_rho(a)| >= 0, equal to 0 iff no zeros right of the line; at a = 1 it is exactly Balazard-Saias-Yor. Decides RH but cannot locate zeros: an off-line quadruple contributes about 2 delta/gamma^2.

name: Minimum-phase identity on vertical lines
statement: For 1/2 <= sigma < 1, F_sigma = zeta(s)(s-1)/(s + 1 - 2 sigma): arg F_sigma(sigma + it) = H_sigma[log|zeta(sigma + i.)|](t) + arg B_sigma(sigma + it), B_sigma the Blaschke product over zeros with beta > sigma; exact Hilbert relation iff no zeros right of sigma (sigma = 1/2: RH).

name: Sawtooth lemma for S(T)
statement: If |S_1(t2) - S_1(t1)| <= A(t2) and rho = theta'/pi, then S(t) <= A(t+delta)/delta + delta rho(t+delta)/2 and S(t) >= -A(t)/delta - delta rho(t)/2; optimal delta gives |S(t)| <= sqrt(2 A rho)(1+o(1)): 5.6748 against 6.6612 at 3e12. Input constant (Trudgian 2011) unchecked.
